zero_arc_note: today opened with a latched SENSOR_INIT (firmware boot probe of ADS1115 failed, main.c:1947-1953). The acquisition script accepts a latched SENSOR_READ when the counters prove a recovery, but SENSOR_INIT is a different code and would have aborted every round with "initial sensor fault". ManualPump_Start calls BP_Control_Reset (main.c:699), which sets s_fault back to NONE, so a 0.6 s start/stop cleared it and the fault field has read code=0 since. The zero itself then wandered between -0.54 and +1.44 over the card as the leak and valve probes cycled pressure; a final vent brought it to -0.38 and the firmware accepted profile peak immediately.
